item.title: T3 Code Review 2026: Open-Source Control Plane for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode
item.description: T3 Code is not a coding agent. It is an open-source control plane that wraps Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, and OpenCode under one browser UI — and that distinction matters more than any feature comparison. If you already use multiple coding agents and are tired of context-switching between terminals, the project is worth a serious look. If you expect it to replace your agent or give you free inference, you will be disappointed.
